description.value:
Your companion is a shotalashu, a telepathic creature originally from Castrovel. It has the beast trait instead of the animal trait but otherwise functions as an animal companion.

Support Benefit The shotalashu telepathically assails your enemies when you create an opening. Until the start of your next turn, each time you hit a creature in the shotalashu's reach with a Strike, the creature takes 1d6 mental damage from the shotalashu. If your shotalashu is burly or deft, the mental damage increases to 2d6.

Advanced Maneuver @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.companion-types.Item.Telepathic Pounce]{Telepathic Pounce}

Special The shotalashu has the mount special ability. Bonding with one typically takes a week and a successful DC 21 Occultism check to establish a telepathic link. A rider with telepathy, touch telepathy, group chat, empathic sense, or a spell such as telepathy gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this check. The link lasts until one of them dies.
